stacking.v5: exact single-policy identity, epoch, domain and macroedge binding

problem.finding: V3/V4 require a global single-owned-policy receipt and per-edge induced-by-bound-policy receipts but do not structurally bind those receipts to one exact policy identity, policy implementation blob, policy epoch, claimed acceptance domain, or exact macroedge bytes.
problem.consequence: A split-policy certificate can satisfy every inherited Boolean obligation while edge witnesses are supplied by different policies, recreating the forbidden forall-edge-exists-policy quantifier order.

independent_logic_check.formula: ((b11 OR b12) AND (b21 OR b22)) AND NOT((b11 AND b21) OR (b12 AND b22))
independent_logic_check.interpretation: Each of two edges has a policy witness, but no single policy witnesses both edges.

repair.effect: The inherited V4 verifier can accept the explicit split-policy witness; V5 rejects it before inherited acceptance/graph checks.
